Assistant

First-course-full rule. The first course uses a full sheet length L; only subsequent courses are reduced by the end lap E. Treating all courses as (L−E) would wrongly deduct a nonexistent lap from the first course.

Columns. Effective cover C already includes side lap, so columns = ceil(W/C) = ceil(8/0.8) = 10. Do not reduce C further.

Courses. Courses = 1 if 0 < R ≤ L; otherwise 1 + ceil((R−L)/(L−E)).

R = 5 m (equals L): courses = 1. Coverage to 5.0 m.
Just above 5 m: (R−L)/(L−E) > 0, so courses = 2.
R = 9.8 m: 1 + ceil((9.8−5)/4.8) = 1 + ceil(1.0) = 2. First course 5.0 m + second 4.8 m = 9.8 m exactly.
Just above 9.8 m: ratio > 1, courses = 3.

At an exact coverage boundary the lower course count holds; immediately above, one more course is needed.

Totals. Sheets = 10 × 2 = 20. Ordered linear metres = 20 × 5 = 100 m.

This is a worksheet convention, not installation or product-suitability approval.

Developer review

Outcome: rule, columns (10), courses at each boundary (1/2/2/3), totals (20 sheets, 100 m) stated clearly.
Friction: none evident; boundary cases walked through explicitly.

Draft/whole vs filtered subtree. Whole = everything exported; subtree = items assigned to that node or its descendants. A=0.10 m² (Walls) enters both Walls and Building; B=0.20 m² is unassigned → whole only; C=3 lm (Walls) enters Walls and Building; D=4 m² (Building) → Building only.

Building rollup (m²): A 0.10 + D 4.00 = 4.10 (unverified + inferred, kept separate). Walls (m²): A 0.10 unverified. Walls (lm): C 3.00 sample. Reporting Building as 0.10 + 4.10 double-counts A. Never sum inclusive parent and child m².

Flat item-only CSV: only LEAF rows. Sum each per (unit, evidence class): whole m² unverified 0.30; whole m² inferred 4.00; whole lm sample 3.00. Subtree m² unverified 0.10; subtree m² inferred 4.00; subtree lm sample 3.00.

Hierarchical CSV: distinguish SUMMARY_NODE (rollup) from LEAF_ITEM. Sum LEAF rows only; report, do not re-add, summary.

Apostrophe. '=1+1 neutralises formula parsing; display varies by importer.
